Description
Overview
The universal hardness tester VisionLine provides versatile hardness testing from micro to macro for production and laboratory use. It supports Vickers, Knoop, Brinell, Rockwell as well as carbon and plastics testing. Intuitive operation via touch display, PC or MotionControl control unit. Available in semi-automatic and fully automatic versions. The system includes a configurable tool changer (up to 8 positions), AI-assisted evaluation (ecos™ III) and a high-precision optics and camera system.
Applications
Single hardness tests
Row and identical-part testing
Hardness testing on gears, welds, Jominy specimens and various component geometries
Testing on steel, aluminium, copper, brass, gold, ceramics, carbon and plastics

Vickers
Knoop
Brinell
Rockwell
Carbon testing
Ball indentation hardness

Standard: 0.3 - 250 kg
Optional: from 0.01 kg (10 g) or 0.3 g depending on model

Product advantages
Wide load range 0.01 kg – 250 kg (depending on configuration)
Suitable for Vickers, Knoop, Brinell, Rockwell, carbon and plastics testing
Automatic brightness control and AI-assisted evaluation for efficient, reliable results
Simple control via touch display, PC or MotionControl
Available in semi-automatic and fully automatic configurations
Functions / Highlights
Up to 8-position freely configurable tool changer (objectives, indenters, laser, Brinell SmartLight)
Optional load extension (enables very low loads)
Modular external control (6th generation) for easy maintenance and retrofitting
Clamping systems and extensive accessories (prism, flat and ball test tables, bases, positioning laser)
Software ecos™ III with Quicktest, series measurement and panorama function; AI-assisted evaluation

Note
The VisionLine family includes models with different test stands, camera configurations and equipment options. The exact configuration (test travel, table size, maximum workpiece height and weight, power consumption) depends on the chosen model.
Technical characteristics / specifications
Load range (series): 0.3 - 250 kg (optional from 0.01 kg / 10 g depending on model)
Max. test height: Vision 250 = 220 mm; Vision 250-Z = 175 mm; Vision 250-Z Pro = 175 mm
Test table: Vision 250 / 250-Z Ø 90 mm; Vision 250-Z Pro 150 x 200 mm
Evaluation camera resolution: 12 Mpix with CMOS sensor
Max. workpiece weight: Vision 250 / 250-Z = 200 kg; Vision 250-Z Pro = 60 kg
Operating system (standard PC models): Windows 11
Ambient temperature (according to ISO/ASTM): +5 °C to +40 °C
Relative humidity: max. 70 % (non-condensing)
Protection class: IP20
Power consumption (depending on model): examples from datasheets: 120/50 W, 720/100 W, 600/100 W (model-dependent)
Typical dimensions (W×D×H, dependent on model): e.g. 305 x 680 x 1271.5 mm (Vision 250) or 645 x 680 x 1216.5 mm (Vision 250-Z Pro)
